dataset.shard: blip_laion_cc_sbu_558k.json#rows[0:3000] (bounded window of the single pretrain split; images.zip members for admitted roots)
dataset.composition_note: General LAION/CC/SBU web-image subset; includes product photography and some graphic/illustrative images. Captions are raw upstream alt-text. Admission verifies provenance, terms, decode, uniqueness and split/label separation, not semantic caption-image agreement.

terms.license_expression: other (research-use-only filtered image bundle; permissive caption text with attribution)

components.name: LAION/CC/SBU filtered image subset (images.zip)
components.terms: Card states the re-hosted images are provided for research reproduction only, must comply with the LAION/CC/SBU licence, should not be used for any other purpose, and may be withdrawn on request of the original owners.

components.name: CC-3M caption text
components.terms: Card states the dataset may be freely used for any purpose with acknowledgement of Google LLC as the data source; provided AS IS without warranty.

components.name: Caption text as shipped in the annotation answer field
components.terms: The pinned card declares the raw CC-3M caption as the default answer, but the sampled answer text is textually identical to metadata.blip_caption, so a BLIP-synthetic origin cannot be excluded. CC-3M text is freely usable with acknowledgement of Google LLC; if the text is BLIP-generated, the card requires compliance with the BLIP licence and attribution. Both acknowledgements are recorded.
components.provenance_note: Per-row origin is not distinguishable from the pinned artifacts; the ambiguity is recorded in every row instead of being guessed.

components.name: LLaVA-Pretrain instruction wrappers
components.terms: Generated prompt templates from the pinned annotation file; underlying image and caption terms govern the admitted content.

reserved_family_avoidance.note: The audit reserved coco_root_image for evaluation and blocked LLaVA-Instruct-150K because it derives from that family. LLaVA-Pretrain is the declared V1 alignment candidate and draws from the LAION/CC/SBU filtered subset instead.

sampling.order: ascending sha256('<seed>:<upstream_id>') over the first 3000 pinned upstream rows
